title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 23: The Block Remembers

scenes.say: They invite him back to the old block for a community day.
scenes.visual: a Newark street closed off for a block party, balloons and tables, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Same street where he sat in that Cutlass with a gun in his lap.
scenes.visual: an empty parking spot on a Newark street, sunlight on the curb, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: This time, he parks and opens the trunk. Books, not guns.
scenes.visual: an open car trunk filled with boxes of books, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The little girl from the porch is grown now. A nurse.
scenes.visual: a young woman in scrubs smiling, seen from the side, sunny street, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: She says, you're the one who knocked on my door that night.
scenes.visual: a rowhouse porch in daylight, freshly painted, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Dre didn't make it. But she did. And she's proud of him.
scenes.visual: a mural on a brick wall with angel wings and flowers, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Kids line up for free haircuts, school supplies and his book.
scenes.visual: kids lined up at a folding table on a sidewalk, sunny day, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Old heads who called him a hoodlum now call him Sarge.
scenes.visual: older men on a stoop nodding, faces turned away, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The block that raised him finally sees what it raised.
scenes.visual: a wide shot of a Newark block full of people celebrating, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a street sign at the corner glowing in golden hour light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Twenty Four. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: kids running down a sunny Newark sidewalk, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 23 of 25: The Block Remembers. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
